answer: Bind each agent key to a licensed amateur radio callsign. Each epoch the licensee transmits a short signed beacon carrying the key hash, logged by independent receiving stations, so the key proves a real station on the air. Callsigns sharing an address or heard from one transmitter site merge into one share. One ham running an agent from a desert oasis pays a single exam fee, but alias n+1 needs another person to pass the exam under their own name, and a tide of new licences from one club gets audited.
